## Self-review checklist

Check these **before** you request a review.

### Code quality

- [ ] I ran `pnpm check` locally and it passed
- [ ] I ran `pnpm build` locally and it passed
- [ ] I used **semantic color classes** from our design system (not random hex values)
- [ ] I put files in the right folders (`components/`, `lib/`, `types/`, etc.)
- [ ] I removed `console.log`, commented-out code, and unused imports

### If I used AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Cursor, etc.)

- [ ] I **read and understood** every line I am submitting
- [ ] I tested the code myself — I did not copy-paste without running it
- [ ] I checked for common AI mistakes (wrong imports, fake APIs, overly complex code)
- [ ] I renamed variables and simplified code so it matches our project style
